d: Luka Dončić continues to cement his place in NBA history! With his latest 53-point performance, Luka has scored 40+ points in four consecutive games, becoming just the fourth player in Los Angeles Lakers franchise history to accomplish the feat, joining Kobe Bryant, Elgin Baylor, and George Mikan. He is the first Laker to record four straight 40-point games since Kobe Bryant did so from January 10-14, 2012.
